title: Sweat to Fit
description: Real-life RPG stat system in minecraft. Start with a very weak character, but train and improve them over time and with effort!
body:
**Warning:** This RPG mod is very specific and intended for a narrow audience (VERY CURSED MOD).

If you like sports and would like to combine real-life training with training your character in Minecraft, this mod is for you. It allows you to train various character attributes by performing various exercises: squats, push-ups, sit-ups, and so on. Of course, this mod is based on trust. 

For balance, at the beginning of the game, the character starts out EXTREMELY WEAK! 
0.5 health, half the damage and attack speed, and food consumption increased 5 times! In addition, breaking blocks also consumes food. I also embedded the [Craft Takes Time](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/craft-time) mod and made the crafting time very long, specifically so that people would train in between crafting sessions.

You will have to train a lot to become even slightly strong. To get close to standard stats, you need to level up 50 skill levels, but you can continue training up to level 100 max. 

## Full list of skills:
- **Combat Power** - Increases your melee attack damage.
- **Fencing** - Allows you to strike faster with melee weapons.
- **Mastery** - Increases the chance of obtaining a good modifier when crafting/reforging tools (TieredZ)
- **Endurance** - Reduces hunger depletion when performing actions.
- **Mining** - Increases block breaking speed.
- **Archery** - Decreases bows/crossbows draw time.
- **Toughening** - Increases maximum health.
- **Athletics** - Increases running and walking speed.
- **Dexterity** - Reduces the time required to craft items.
- **Respiration** - Increases the time you can stay underwater.

To open skill panel, press **K** (default).

_You may experience pain while playing Minecraft with this mod. This is normal._
